usage:
hergy - teams and roles, one level above Herdr

Usage:
  hergy up [team] [--dry] [--global|--local] [--timeout ms] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy down [team] [--dry] [--global|--local] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy refresh <member>|--all [--team team] [--global|--local] [--dry] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy hire <name> --profile P --purpose X --task "…" [--from member] [--team team] [--global|--local] [--timeout ms] [--dry] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy ls [--global|--local] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy show <team> [--global|--local] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy new <team> [--local] [--lang en|ja] [-C project]
  hergy validate [--lang en|ja] [-C project]

Commands:
  up        Boot a team. With --dry, print the plan without touching Herdr
  down      Close the live members' panes. With --dry, print what would close, closing nothing
  refresh   Re-submit the bootstrap prompt to idle members (--all for everyone)
  hire      Start one worker in a separate tab. Note anything outside may_spawn and continue
  ls        List the visible teams with their layer
  show      Print the effective config and where each value and document came from
  new       Write a starter team's files (global by default; --local for the project)
  validate  Check every settings file the way up reads it, and show each broken one

Language:
  --lang en|ja selects the language (default en). The global config.yaml can set lang; --lang wins.

Team resolution:
  Call by name. Local (<project>/.hergy/teams/<name>/team.yaml) first, then global
  ($XDG_CONFIG_HOME/hergy/teams/<name>/team.yaml, or ~/.config/hergy/ when unset).
  A name in both resolves to local. With no name, a single local team is used; otherwise the candidates are listed.
  The project root is the git root (or the current directory); -C overrides it.

  Set HERGY_HERDR to replace the herdr executable (for checking with a fake herdr).
error.timeout_not_int: --timeout must be an integer in milliseconds: %q
error.hire_needs_name: hergy hire needs exactly one worker name
error.ls_no_args: hergy ls takes no positional arguments: %v
error.validate_no_args: hergy validate takes no positional arguments: %v
error.show_needs_team: hergy show needs a team name
error.new_needs_name: hergy new needs a team name
error.new_exists: a team named %q already exists: %s (nothing written)
error.not_under_herdr: run inside a Herdr-managed shell pane (HERDR_ENV=1 and HERDR_PANE_ID are required)
error.need_team_name: name a team (there are %d local teams)
error.version_missing: %s: version is missing (this build reads version: 1 only; migrate is not implemented): %s
error.team_name_mismatch: %s: team is %q but the resolved name is %q (they must match because teams resolve by name)
error.builtin_not_allowed: %q is not allowed (hergy has no built-in layer; put the documents in the team directory)
error.docs_missing: docs: no such file or directory: %s
error.prompt_empty_team: prompt must be a nonempty string
error.needs_profile_or_kind: %s needs a profile or a kind
error.must_be_mapping_not_null: %s must be a mapping, not null
error.not_plain_kind: %s must be a plain agent kind
error.no_role_file_no_dirs: no role file for %s (there is nowhere to look; put the role file in the team's roles/ or point roles at a directory)
error.profiles_moved: (team.yaml no longer has profiles; profiles live in profiles.yaml)
error.no_may_spawn: %s has no may_spawn in the config
error.live_names_in_use: live agent names already in use: %s
error.herdr_agent_object: unexpected Herdr response: agent is not an object
error.live_mismatch: %s: live name/kind does not match the config
error.reset_before_refresh: %s: status=%q; reset/settle the agent before refreshing
error.herdr_not_advertise: installed Herdr does not advertise %s %s; inspect `herdr %s`
error.herdr_no_result: Herdr response has no result object
error.herdr_not_string: unexpected Herdr response: %s is not a string
show.profiles_none: profiles: none (only when members spell kind/args inline)
show.docs_header: Documents (in the order the team lists them):
resolution.global_overridden: a team with this name is also global (local overrides): %s
resolution.local_used: a team with this name is also local (global used): %s
launcher.boot_submitted: Bootstrap prompts submitted; document reading continues in each pane.
down.absent_only: No member of team %q is present; nothing to close.
down.dry_done: Dry run: %s (%d would close, %d not present)
progress.kept: Existing panes/processes are kept. A failed request may already have taken effect.
progress.inspect: Inspect live state before retrying; bootstrap prompts are never retried automatically.
herdr.guide:
- To a member: `herdr agent prompt <name> "<text>"`. Start the text with "%s".
- To the human: write in your own pane.
- For anything else: `herdr agent --help`.
spawn.note:
## Spawning workers
When needed, you may spawn workers for these purposes: %s
Profiles you may use: %s
How to spawn: `%s`
The worker starts in another tab and reports back to you (%s) when done. Worker names are lower-case ASCII and must not collide with the roster.
